title: Dual circuit-processing step
statement: Given an input index $i_0\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, a state consisting of a list of statements and a list of rails, and a gate $g$, apply the gate-emission procedure to $g$ at the current statement-list length, using the rails selected by the gate’s argument indices from the current rail list. Append the emitted statements to the statement list and the emitted rail to the rail list.
hypotheses_covered: A state consisting of a list of statements and a list of rails
caveat: The provided statement omits the definitions of the gate-emission procedure and rail lookup, so their precise behavior cannot be stated from the supplied ground truth.
